name: pi-goals
description: Persistent goal tracking for Pi with /tree-compatible state, budgets, reusable prompts, and churn monitoring.

scripts.slop:goal: if rg -n 'as unknown as|as any' .pi/extensions/goal; then exit 1; else exit 0; fi
scripts.quality:goal: sentrux gate .pi/extensions/goal && sentrux check .pi/extensions/goal && npm run slop:goal && npm run typecheck:goal && pi --offline --no-session --no-tools -e .pi/extensions/goal/index.ts --list-models >/tmp/pi-goal-quality-load.txt

author: Bryan Price-McConnahea (@slopwareindy // withbryan.work)
